optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Mobile Application Engineer, Enterprise Knowledge Base
professionalSummary: Developed the delta-sync module for the knowledge base app (Kotlin and Swift), replacing full-catalogue downloads with change-set downloads and resumable transfers when field devices lose connectivity (src_dae6e793a75d).

Reduced the sync failure rate from 6.8% to 2.1% of sync attempts between the March and June releases, measured by the app analytics dashboard against the product's published baseline of 6.8% for the January to February period (src_4422dd59369a).
Coordinated release contents with the content team for four releases, covering sync and search changes while the release manager set release dates and scope (src_c63c285941f0).
Triaged crash and sync reports from field staff through the support queue, documenting root causes in the engineering wiki and linking each to the fixing change (src_70b22146f286).
Held responsibilities for offline sync development, quality-indicator reporting, release coordination and support triage for the knowledge base app over about two years (src_909c23b122bf).
projectsAndWorkSamples: Sync-failure-rate report exported from the app analytics dashboard and delta-sync design note, with dashboard export identifiers as verification trail (src_e0770995b259).
